properties.description: Parallel master pipeline using Lookup + ForEach (parallel, batchCount=5). Reads all active source_names from ev_catalog.ctl.pipeline_control and runs up to 5 sources simultaneously. Use when sources are independent and Databricks cluster can handle concurrent job submissions. batchCount controls max parallelism — tune based on cluster size.

activities.name: act_lookup_sources
activities.description: Read all active source names from the control table. ForEach will iterate over the returned rows.

source.query: SELECT source_name FROM ev_catalog.ctl.pipeline_control WHERE is_active = true ORDER BY source_name

activities.name: act_foreach_source_parallel
activities.description: Run up to 5 sources at the same time. isSequential=false, batchCount=5. Each iteration calls the child pipeline independently.

activities.name: act_run_source
activities.description: Call the incremental load pipeline for this iteration's source_name

p_load_type_override.description: Pass 'full' to force full reload for all sources. Leave empty to use each source's load_type from the control table.
